test_f_gold: test the f_gold function to check if an array of size n is sorted in non-decreasing order
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function that iterates through an array and returns True if sorted
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function that checks array sorted status iteratively
refactor_f_gold: refactor the f_gold function to implement the same sorted check recursively instead of iteratively
run_f_gold: run the f_gold function with test arrays and verify results against f_filled
